question: What is the main purpose of BRICS?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Economic cooperation and development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary purpose of **BRICS** is to enhance **Economic cooperation and development** among its member nations. It serves as a platform for **emerging market economies** to collaborate on trade, investment, and sustainable development.
 
• **BRICS** is an acronym for five major emerging national economies: **Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa**. These nations are characterized by their significant influence on **regional affairs** and the **global economy**.
 
• The grouping aims to provide an alternative to the existing **Western-led global financial system**, specifically challenging the dominance of the **International Monetary Fund (IMF)** and the **World Bank**.
 
• It represents nearly **42% of the world's population**, **30% of the world's land area**, and approximately **24% of the global GDP**, making it a powerful economic bloc.
